text: ポケモンの　さまよえる　れいよ　やすらかに…

structure.jp: ポケモンの　さまよえる　れいよ

patterns.name: 〜よ (calling)
patterns.explanation: よ right after a noun, in solemn old-style speech, calls out to that someone, like 'O ...'. れいよ = 'O spirits'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb put right before a noun describes that noun; さまよえる is an old literary form of さまよう meaning 'wandering'. さまよえる れい = 'spirits that wander'.
